Summer Camps
services.desc: We can’t wait to welcome campers for an unforgettable summer! Get ready for hands‑on police‑themed activities, new friendships, and the chance to meet some special Calgary Police Service guests. CPS special guest visits are subject to their availability and cannot be guaranteed. Camp hours are from 8:30 AM to 4:15 PM each day. Drop-off time will be between 8:30- 9:00 AM and pick-up time will be between 3:45 PM - 4:15 PM. We will again be offering three camp tiers tailored to different age groups - ensuring smaller, age-appropriate experiences that are fun, engaging and, of course, unforgettable! services.desc: Social Savvy is our Grade 9 Provincial Achievement Test (PAT) review experience, designed to help students make meaningful connections between curriculum and the world around them. Through the lens of historical and modern policing, we challenge students to dig deeper into the why behind the content, while sharpening the critical thinking skills they’ll need for the exam… and for life. Social Savvy reinforces core Grade 9 Social Studies curriculum concepts while creating space for discussion, curiosity, and deeper understanding. It’s PAT prep, reimagined. it’s a chance to invest in the kind of early education that changes lives.This program empowers students to engage with the world more
